name: vtruncnorm
title: Variance. A far interval uses the uniform variance (b - a)^2 / 12.

origin.description: Variance. A far interval uses the uniform variance (b - a)^2 / 12.
origin.details: Variances of a central interval, a far interval, and a left tail.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(truncnorm))
cat(paste(sprintf("%.17g", c(vtruncnorm(-1, 1), vtruncnorm(8, 9), vtruncnorm(2, Inf, 0, 2))), collapse = ","))
